title: 第617章 反目第616章 绝峰断云掌
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 泉庸很早就注意到了这个叫做钟无赦的渊剑宗弟子。
尽管在他身上看不出任何常规天才修士的特征，无论是狂妄又或是天赋型的直觉，都没有一丝一毫。
完全像是一个极为普通的宗门弟子。
但多年的直觉告诉泉庸，若是不尽快处理掉此人，将来必将成为一代强敌。
第一次错判发生在那场元婴渡劫。
当时泉庸判断，那个雷劫的幅度只巨大，绝非一个初入元婴的小修士能够抵御，就算是许多化神修士都得被直接劈死，下意识以为钟无赦渡劫失败已死。
再加上后来钟无赦确实没有再露面，泉庸便将重心放到了联合北夏其他宗门，布局袭击渊剑宗上。
当钟无赦再度出面时，已经成长到了一个相当了不得的地位，在幻海碧窟出尽风头。
就连泉庸派出的两位化神都被其击败。
不能再拖了，这是泉庸的想法。
他并不是那种会让属下从低到高挨个送人头给对面送起来的蠢货上司，见钟无赦有这般威胁，便决定亲自出手。
只是这钟无赦似乎有高人指点，偷偷从幻海碧窟中逃离，让泉庸扑了个空。
之后又在渊剑宗内隐蔽，许久不出现。
在毁灭渊剑宗的行动开始后，为了确保能将钟无赦灭杀，泉庸特地布置了数十位化神修士蹲守钟无赦的撤退路线。
并不是泉庸犯浑了，只是渊剑宗作为一个存在千年的强大宗门，所拥有的底蕴不是灭杀几个明面上的化神长老能够解决的。
一旦发动灭宗之战，便会有不知道多少闭死关老东西出马，作为联盟中唯一的合体境修士，泉庸必须在正面战场压阵。
谁想得到，数十位化神修士联手，都没能遏制住这钟无赦，等到泉庸接到告急消息，匆匆赶来时，现场的诸多化神修士已经陨落了一大半。
其中，还包括泉庸辛苦灌顶培育出来的新时代青云阁化神。
这些被灌顶培育出来的化神，每一个都消耗了泉庸不知多少底蕴储备，乃是往后泉庸拿来争夺北夏霸权的最重要部队。
此回下放来针对钟无赦，既是为了避开正面战场那些富有经验的渊剑宗化神，也是为了练兵。
迎来的，却是几乎全灭的消息，这怎能让泉庸不感到愤怒？
一怒之下，泉庸不顾隐藏实力，直接出手，一记绝峰断云掌出手，便是要将这钟无赦彻底灭杀。
结局却不像他想象中的那样摧枯拉朽。
钟无赦不避反进，朝上轰出一招闻所未闻的‘无道皆杀拳’
泉庸只感觉有一座山狠狠的砸在了自己的小脚趾上，只一下，青玉巨掌便被打的碎裂开来，连带着他本体的手臂也开始崩溃。
若不是多年斗法的经验让他在第一时间切断了手臂和身躯的联系，恐怕这股诡异的崩溃之力还会继续传导上来。
靠着合体境蛮横的修为强行将钟无赦镇压，仍有后怕的泉庸在确定此人的确被灭杀后，这才匆匆赶回了青云阁的驻地。
丢掉一条手臂，对于合体境修士来说也是重创，更别说强行改变招式造成的反噬。
泉庸现在只想好好闭关调息，将紊乱的身体重新调整过来。
嘎吱…
正运功回气间，洞府的大门突然开启，发出了声响。
“我不是说了不要打扰……是你？”
content_en:
Quanyong noticed this disciple of Yuanjian Sect named Zhong Wushe very early on.
Although there is no characteristic of conventional genius monks in him, there is not even a trace of arrogance or gifted intuition.
Completely like an extremely ordinary sect disciple.
But years of intuition tell Quan Yong that if this person is not dealt with as soon as possible, he will definitely become a powerful enemy in the future.
The first miscarriage of justice occurred during the Nascent Soul Tribulation.
At that time, Quan Yong judged that the magnitude of the thunder catastrophe was huge, and it was definitely not something that a young monk who had just entered the Nascent Soul could withstand. Even many monks who transformed themselves into gods would have been killed directly. He subconsciously thought that Zhong Wushe had failed to overcome the catastrophe and died.
In addition, Zhong Wushe did not show up again, so Quanyong focused on uniting other sects in Northern Xia to plan an attack on Yuanjian Sect.
When Zhong Wushe showed up again, he had grown to a rather remarkable position and was the star of the Phantom Sea Blue Cave.
Even the two gods sent by Quan Yong were defeated by him.
It can't be delayed any longer, this is Quan Yong's idea.
He was not the kind of stupid boss who would let his subordinates give away their heads one by one from low to high to the other side. Seeing that Zhong Wushe was such a threat, he decided to take action himself.
It's just that Zhong Wushe seemed to have been instructed by an expert to escape secretly from the Huanhai Blue Cave, leaving Quanyong in vain.
Afterwards, he hid in Yuanjian Sect and did not appear for a long time.
After the operation to destroy the Yuanjian Sect began, in order to ensure that Zhong Wushe could be killed, Quan Yong specially arranged for dozens of monks to squat on Zhong Wushe's retreat route.
It's not that Quan Yong is being stupid, it's just that Yuanjian Sect, as a powerful sect that has existed for thousands of years, has a rich heritage that cannot be solved by killing a few superficial elders.
Once the war to exterminate the sect is launched, there will be countless old people in retreat. As the only Fusion Realm monk in the alliance, Quan Yong must hold the battle on the frontal battlefield.
Who would have thought that dozens of god-transformation monks joined forces but could not stop Zhong Wushe. When Quan Yong received the urgent news and rushed over, more than half of the god-transformation monks at the scene had already died.
Among them, there is also the new era Qingyun Pavilion transformation god that Quanyong painstakingly cultivated through initiation.
Each of these transformed gods cultivated through initiation consumed Quan Yong's unknown reserves, and they were the most important troops used by Quan Yong in the future to compete for Northern Xia's hegemony.
This time, he was sent down to target Zhong Wushe, not only to avoid the experienced Yuanjian Sect's transformation gods on the frontal battlefield, but also to train his troops.
What came was the news of almost total destruction. How could Quan Yong not feel angry?
In a fit of rage, Quanyong took action directly, regardless of his hidden strength. He struck out with the Peak-breaking Cloud Palm, aiming to completely kill Zhong Wushe.
The ending was not as devastating as he imagined.
Zhong Wushe didn't shy away and advanced forward, launching an unheard-of "Killing Fist for All No Ways" upwards.
Quanyong only felt a mountain hit his little toe hard. In just one click, the giant sapphire palm was shattered, and his body's arm began to collapse.
If his years of experience in fighting had not allowed him to immediately cut off the connection between his arms and his body, I am afraid that this strange force of collapse would have continued to spread.
Relying on the arrogant cultivation of the Fusion Realm, he forcibly suppressed Zhong Wushe. Quan Yong, who was still frightened, hurried back to the Qingyun Pavilion after confirming that this person had indeed been killed.
Losing an arm is also a serious injury to a Fusion Realm monk, not to mention the backlash caused by forcibly changing his moves.
Now Quan Yong just wants to take a good retreat and regulate his breath, and readjust his disordered body.
Crunch…
When Zhengyun Gong was recovering, the door of the cave suddenly opened and made a sound.
"Didn't I tell you not to disturb... was it you?"
